item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t make that precise reframe with the connected tools. They offer generative video editing, not speaker-following crops that reliably preserve all 10 seconds and the original audio.

To get the result in a video editor:
- Set the canvas to **9:16**.
- Split at the change from the man’s question to the woman’s answer.
- Centre the man in the first section and the woman in the second.
- Keep the full 10-second timeline and original audio unchanged, with captions off.

I haven’t modified your file or spent generation credits.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot perform the precise reframe requested and confirms no modified file was produced.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
The free 480p edit was refused because your account has insufficient credits. Nothing was generated, and your original file is unchanged.

Free-plan settings still require generation credits. You’ll need more credits to retry, or you can make the speaker-centred crop in a standard video editor.

approvals.name: edit_video

style.prompt: Reframe this existing conversation into a 9:16 vertical clip. Preserve the entire original 10 seconds in order, at original speed, with the original audio unchanged. Show the man centred in the vertical frame while he asks his question, then cut the framing to show the woman centred while she answers. Time the framing change to the actual speaker change in the source. Only change framing/cropping; preserve the original people, faces, lip movements, setting, actions and dialogue. No captions, subtitles, text overlays, added music, sound effects or new speech.
